name: Aurekobo
backstory: Child of Aurebalo and Mekoboro; raised in Gorff on drives a caravan up and down the transit..., and carries some knowledge of Forliamus Betrothal Offer.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Heard that Khaus and Mekoboro now have a child, Khaoboro.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Auroboro and Aurebalo now have a child, Aureboro.
Grew up hearing: Had a child with Merluko, named Aurebako.
Heard that Aurebalo and Khaoboro now have a child, Aurekhobo.
Heard that Aurebako and Khaoboro now have a child, Khaobako.
Heard that Mekoboro and Khaubaluk now have a child, Mekobaluk.
Had a child with Khaumestro, named Aurekomest.
Heard that Aurekomest and Aurelkhau now have a child, Aurelkomest.
Heard that Khaubaluk and Aurekomest now have a child, Khaubomest.
Heard that Aurekomest and Aurelkhau now have a child, Aureskomest.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only if it stayed close to Death Of Dorakus
criterion.wasted_life: a life spent never once engaging with Death Of Dorakus
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: drives the family's caravan route now, pays the toll without a word, has started asking travelers for news instead of just letting it pass him by

arc.premise: Aurekobo has begun lining up his own drivers and wagons for the wedding-goods escort, provisioning them now so the caravan can leave the moment the betrothal is sealed instead of scrambling to find hands at the last minute.
